angular_histogram.definition: Angle from each valid native64D embedding to its own field mean direction.

methods.mean_angle_deg: Great-circle angle between normalized equal-pixel resultant directions. Lower means closer mean positions.
methods.covariance_overlap_k10: Mean squared cosine of principal angles between top10 centered spherical covariance subspaces after transport to a shared reference. Fraction0–1; higher means more aligned internal variation.
methods.rms_angle_deg: sqrt(mean(angle(pixel, own field mean)^2)), converted to degrees; an angular spread, not a standard deviation around a scalar mean.
methods.reference: Equal-field normalized mean of all8 field mean directions, computed separately for each support and fixed across all28pairs.
methods.covariance: Each complete field is log-mapped at its own extrinsic mean, parallel-transported to the shared reference, projected to an orthonormal63D tangent basis, centered, and divided by n.

support_definitions.all_valid: Every valid displayed embedding, including WorldCover water80 and missing WorldCover.
support_definitions.recognized_land: Every valid embedding with WorldCover10/20/30/40/50/60/70/90/95/100, exactly the original shared-PCA fit mask.

sampling.weighting: Equal weight per displayed lattice location within each field; one equal field weight in the common reference.
sampling.scope: The displayed rectangular fields are not FUA boundaries, and lattice spacing differs across fields. These are full-field descriptive statistics, not the manuscript atlas-city estimates.
sampling.native_geometry: Only original64D analysis-ready coordinates with L2 normalization; no3D projection and no signed-square inverse.
sampling.selection: All8 available displayed fields and all28pairs; no location subsampling or complete-case target restriction.

paper_sections: SI S2: spherical distance, normalized resultant, log map and dispersion
SI: City position and internal-variance orientation share local structure

distributions.method: Equal-weight observed pixels; common 256-bin histograms and reflected Gaussian smoothing. Every curve integrates to one on its declared axis. Categories retain exact observed shares. Missing values excluded only from their own variable.
